what: Read replica of docker-compose.yml (service db-replica) brought up with Docker and checked; then removed

checks.replication_role: the replicator SQL of deploy/migrate.sh ran twice without error (create, then update the password)
checks.replica_first_start: pg_basebackup through slot replica1; healthcheck (pg_is_in_recovery = t) healthy after 6 s; pg_stat_replication: streaming; a row written on the primary was read on the replica
checks.replica_rebuilt_from_empty_volume: the inactive slot replica1 was dropped and recreated; streaming again; data present
checks.startup_rule: db.require_reports_replica() with sandbox off: replica accepted; primary refused ('points at a primary'); no address refused ('is required outside the sandbox')

not_covered_here: The API and worker images were not built in this sandbox; the CI deployment-stack job checks the replica with the full stack
